rendered_example.name: SealMetrics vs Google Analytics 360
rendered_example.description: Side-by-side comparison: SealMetrics enterprise analytics versus Google Analytics 360 (GA360) on data completeness, EU compliance, pricing and AI readiness.

mainEntity.about: Feature-by-feature comparison of SealMetrics vs Google Analytics 360

caller_changes:
All 10 vs/alternatives pages need `datePublished`, `dateModified`, and `author` props added. Pattern (per page):

  comparisonPageSchema({
    name: "...",
    description: "...",
    url: "/vs/ga360",
    competitor: { name: "...", url: "..." },
    datePublished: "2026-04-15",
    dateModified: "2026-05-04",  // bump on edits, by hand — see the note below
    author: { name: "Rafa Jiménez", url: "/authors/rafa-jimenez" },
  })

AMENDED 2026-07-30: this originally proposed a sister script `scripts/build-vs-modified.mjs` to auto-populate dateModified per /vs page from git mtime. Do not build it. The blog equivalent was deleted (#53) because git mtime cannot tell a real content revision from a mechanical sweep — a lint pass or a canonical rewrite bumps every file it touches, and it had already re-dated 30 blog posts (#45). dateModified is a freshness claim to Google and AI engines, so it is author-declared: bump it by hand when the page actually changes. See the rule in CLAUDE.md.
